# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_EXPANSION_BREAK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon (9,20,50) expands rapidly and price breaks above the 50-EMA with elevated volume, it signals the start of a short-term momentum burst. This captures explosive moves that occur after a period of consolidation, distinct from existing ribbon-based strategies that trade pullbacks to the ribbon.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Calculate 9-EMA, 20-EMA, 50-EMA, and ATR(14) on 5-minute bars. If (20-EMA - 9-EMA) > 0.5 * ATR(14) AND price closes above the 50-EMA on a bar with volume > 1.5x the average 5-minute volume over the prior 20 bars, then go long at the close.  
**Exit:** Initial stop is the low of the entry bar. TP1 is set at 2R (twice the risk from entry to stop). After TP1 is hit, the remaining position trails using a Chandelier exit (ATR * 3) from the highest high since entry.  
**Regime filters:** Only active when VIX is between 12-22 and time is between 09:45-11:30 ET. Avoid trading if the ribbon width (20-EMA - 9-EMA) has been < 0.2 * ATR(14) for the prior 3 bars (indicating chop).
